verdict_reason: Row states, commits, PRs and repo keys are recorded consistently, but follow-ups are parked as open questions on done rows with no deferred.md home and one note misnumbers the criteria it changed.

todos.issue: Follow-up work is filed as openQuestions on rows this PR marks done, and some of it lives nowhere else, so it drops out of view once the theme lands. inc-059 (line 1290): the AddressDeleteIT spy fix, which is not in deferred.md and names @SpyBean OperatorRepository although the class is now AddressRepository under @MockitoSpyBean. inc-067 (lines 1394, 1395, 1397): the animals _govuk-frontend.scss requote, the animals and plants MoJ-wrapper fix that drops the GDS Transport @font-face for the whole app, and the start-server.test.js title fix: none is in deferred.md, whose header says everything pushed out lives there. The earlier inc-080 twin fixes (lines 1205-1206) do have deferred.md rows. Line 1396 duplicates deferred.md's OIDC row and disagrees with it about ins-frontend. inc-079's own note says a twin fix 'is a follow-up in deferred.md, not a question'.
todos.fix: Must: every follow-up raised on a done row of this theme has one home in deferred.md, naming the code as it is now, and a done row's openQuestions hold only questions that are still open. One way: add deferred.md rows for the inc-067 SCSS and start-server title twin fixes and the inc-059 AddressDeleteIT fix (AddressRepository, @MockitoSpyBean), merge line 1396 into the existing OIDC row, then remove those entries from openQuestions with tim backlog notes --open-questions.

todos.issue: inc-061's 2026-11-03 note says 'Criteria 9 and 10 rewritten to Design Release 2.1's type step', but the diff deletes the old criteria 9 and 10 (the six role options and 'Branch Address' after a divider) and rewrites criterion 2 instead; today's criteria 9 and 10 are the former 11 ('No Transporter type') and 12 (United Kingdom selected). A reader matching the note to the criteria by number reads the wrong two.
todos.fix: Must: the note says what changed in terms that match the row as it now stands. One way: 'Criterion 2 rewritten to Design Release 2.1's type step ...; the two criteria listing the older six role options and the divider deleted.'
